# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nakwabija, ô Leza wani, wampangile mwanda wa kukuyuka ne kukutota. Pa kifuko kino, nâsama kyakanwa kyami, kukulombola bunkomo-nkomo bobe, kulandapala kwami, ne buipeta bobe, I Kutupu Leza mukwabo enka abe, witabanga mu bya malwa, kudi yewa ukulupie mudi aye mwine.
